messages:
ops-alert: :rotating_light: Canary prod-canary-1 /generate p95 spiked to 1.2s, p99 ~3.8s, upstream 5xx 7.8% (baseline p95 160ms, 5xx <0.1%)
alex (oncall): i'm on it, paging SRE/infra/runtime. @jen @paul @evan ack?
jen (sre): ack, pulling traces & flamegraphs
paul (infra): ack, checking LB/gateway metrics. seeing upstream 502/504 from canary nodes
liz (support): ack — CCing support queue; customers reporting timeouts, starting templated replies
deploy-bot: deploy started: service=inference-worker env=prod-canary version=v3.4.2 rollout_id=r-20260315-1768675300
alex (oncall): pause rollout, drain canary pool. paul can you remove canary hosts from LB now?
paul (infra): executing: kubectl label nodes canary-pool canary-drain=true; envoy set weight=0 for canary
evan (runtime): runtime logs on gw-12 show repeated "kv_cache_eviction" and GC pauses; retry queue growing
jen (sre): traces show kv_reorder_lock_wait spikes; continuous batching queues are queuing for lock; kv cache miss rate up 96%
alex (oncall): seems like v3.4.2 changed KV layout or cache behavior — any config changes in that release?
maria (product): release notes mention matmul kernel tweaks and a KV layout refactor in PR#489
evan (runtime): confirmed: PR#489 changed KV in-memory layout; likely incompatible with live cache warming
jen (sre): p99 traces show lock wait ~2.8s causing head-of-line blocking
liz (support): posting customer update: "Engineers investigating higher latency/timeouts on /generate. We paused the recent canary rollout and are monitoring." :hourglass_flowing_sand:
alex (oncall): options: hotfix vs rollback. hotfix risk high, rollback faster. opinions?
paul (infra): rollback fastest. hotfix binary-incompatible and needs validation
jen (sre): agree — rollback canary to v3.4.1 and validate telemetry
alex (oncall): proceed with rollback
deploy-bot: initiating rollback — to v3.4.1 rollout_id=r-rollback-1768675300
deploy-bot: rollback progress: 20% -> 60% -> 100% (canary replaced)
paul (infra): LB weights restored; canary drained
jen (sre): monitoring: /generate p95 ~170ms within 90s; p99 dropping; 5xx <0.2%
alex (oncall): good. support, update customers
liz (support): updated tickets: "We rolled back the canary; latency back to normal. We'll follow-up with root cause." :white_check_mark:
maria (product): hold v3.4.2 across channels until postmortem
evan (runtime): collecting logs, kvcache traces, core dumps; opening INC-20260315-1768675300 investigation
jen (sre): hypothesis: PR#489 KV layout change + new kernel path caused cache incompat -> eviction storm -> reorder lock -> stalls
paul (infra): envoy showed upstream_rq_5xx:780, upstream_rq_504:412 during window; also saw CPU steal on host gw-12
alex (oncall): severity sev2 — customer-visible timeouts; paged; rollback done in ~15m
alex (oncall): follow-ups: postmortem owner, retain telemetry 30d, create compatibility preflight
evan (runtime): taking postmortem ownership; initial timeline draft EOD
jen (sre): add alert: kv_reorder_lock_wait >200ms
paul (infra): implement canary preflight check for KV layout compatibility
liz (support): prepare templated customer communication for timeout spikes
maria (product): release hold for v3.4.2; adjust release checklist
deploy-bot: incident record INC-20260315-1768675300 assigned to evan severity=2
alex (oncall): closing channel after 30m quiet window; good job team :thumbsup:
ops-alert: Alert resolved: closure ts=1768675690 — p95/p99 back to baseline, 5xx reduced

--- END THREAD ---

artifacts:
- rollback command: "deployctl rollback --service inference-worker --to v3.4.1 --rollout-id r-rollback-1768675300 --target canary"
- trace grep: "rg \"kv_reorder_lock_wait\" /var/log/inference/*.log | head"
- envoy stats snippet: "upstream_rq_5xx: 780, upstream_rq_504: 412, upstream_response_time_p95_ms: 1180"

post-incident todos:
- evan: repro + failing test for KV layout + live cache eviction
- jen: add trace-based alert for kv_reorder_lock_wait >200ms
- paul: canary host preflight for KV layout compatibility
- support: templated customer message
- product: hold v3.4.2 and review release checklist
